GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then worked forward out Wide eventually taking the lead and crossing, led 2 Lengths rail by the 1300m, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, got away rounding turn and kept going in Straight # bolted in
Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2.5 Lead on fence, bowled along in front, led 1.5 Lengths turning, got away rounding turn then raced well clear in Straight # led/dominant win

Jumped okay,4-3 Wide into first turn, Moved Up and Settled Down Two Wide trailing just over a length, forced 3 Wide at 1000m, Held Together same middle stages, Moved Up to trail 3 Wide by a half length turning, held own situation but couldn't find another gear in straight. (Winkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # Wide last 1000/fair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early and obliged to race three wide from the 1000m. Laid in when placed under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well Wide out pushing on settled down Two Wide second 1 Lengths (1000m), middle of three up front approaching Turn , Straightened Up Under Pressure soon faded out of it # pace/faded straight
Jumped well off a Wide gate pushing on crossed & led just over a length (1000m), margin narrowed To The Turn , Straightened Up left fence, joined 200, rallied hard just outgunned # crossed/led/good

Debut for stable. Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced keenly Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & chased solidly Four Wide in last 150m. blinkers off first time. # Excellent return
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Inclined to pull in the early stages. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Two Wide of 4 early Took sit 4th 1x1 3 Lengths off leader/winner Under Pressure x 500m, Couldn'T Go On Straightening Up and weakened right out - # cardiac arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed cardiac arrythmia. Vet clearance, inclusive of ECG results and a satisfactory cardiac auscultation vet report post gallop of at least 1000m required prior to being permitted to race again. Cleared to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 2nd 1 Lengths Ridden Along x 600 2 Lengths Couldn'T Go On Turning for home - was Quickly Beaten - Jockey R. Dolan reported the gelding made an increased respiratory noise on pulling up. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have increased lung sounds - # increase lung sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported gelding made an increased respiratory noise on pulling up. A post-race vet exam revealed increased lung sounds. Vet clearance prior to resuming.
